name: Mustard Seed
overview: The mustard seed, though the smallest of seeds, serves as a powerful illustration of the kingdom of heaven and the nature of faith in Christ's teaching. Jesus compares the kingdom to a mustard seed that grows into the greatest of herbs, becoming a tree that provides shelter, symbolizing the expansive and transformative power of God's kingdom (Matthew 13:31-32; Mark 4:30-31). Additionally, He emphasizes that faith as small as a mustard seed can accomplish great works, including moving mountains, highlighting the sufficiency of even the smallest measure of genuine faith when rooted in Him (Matthew 17:20; 21:21).
